note: Date & time pickers page, date half (55412:15781): building blocks (calendar cell, year, menu button), modal (day / year / full-screen range), docked (day / month / year) and input (single / range) date pickers. The kit's calendar is fictitious (an August that starts on a Tuesday): fixtures lay out July 2025 and pass the kit's labels through the formatter.

modal-day.allowedDiffReason: Kit slip: the modal (day) picker's selected day overrides its label to label-large (14/20 Medium); the building block, the docked picker and the full-screen range keep body-large. We render body-large (the "17" glyphs, ~110px) plus ~30 glyph-edge pixels.

modal-year.allowedDiffReason: Kit typo: the year grid's fourth row reads 2030, 2030, 2031 (real years 2030, 2031, 2032 — two labels differ, ~200px); the rest is glyph-edge raster.

day-outside-enabled.allowedDiffReason: Kit slip: the building block's enabled outside-month day is On Surface 38%; the docked picker's outside days and this cell's own hovered / focused variants use On Surface Variant. We render On Surface Variant 38%.

docked-day.allowedDiffReason: Glyph-edge raster of a few day numbers (Figma vs Chrome text AA); layout and colours match.

docked-month.allowedDiffReason: The kit's scroll thumb is decoration (8.8 x 79.5 at the same spot in both lists, whatever the scroll position); ours is a working thumb sized and placed by the list's scroll (336 / 576 of the track). Plus ~80 glyph-edge pixels.

docked-year.allowedDiffReason: The kit's scroll thumb is decoration (8.8 x 79.5 at the same spot in both lists, whatever the scroll position); ours is a working thumb sized and placed by the list's scroll (336 / 576 of the track). The kit's list sits at x 0.3 (the selected row's layer edge, 96px) plus glyph-edge raster.

input-single.allowedDiffReason: The kit draws the format hint "mm/dd/yyyy" in the input-text colour (On Surface); it is the field's placeholder (Compose DateInput: placeholder = the date pattern), which we render in the placeholder colour (On Surface Variant).

input-range.allowedDiffReason: The kit draws the format hint "mm/dd/yyyy" in the input-text colour (On Surface); it is the field's placeholder (Compose DateInput: placeholder = the date pattern), which we render in the placeholder colour (On Surface Variant).

modal-range.allowedDiffReason: Glyph-edge raster of a few day numbers (Figma vs Chrome text AA); layout, range bands and colours match.
